summary: Kootenai NF tower in Lincoln County, MT: a 1938 50-foot pole L-4 tower, destroyed 1960 per firelookout.com; listed gone. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; firelookout.com says the tower was destroyed in 1960. No source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: One-acre fire at the head of Cripple Horse Creek, cause not given, which the memoir associates with the Weigal Mountain lookout; the memoir places it within its account of a bad July 1940 fire season

notes_for_editor: Two independent history sources: firelookout.com (1938 tower, never manned, destroyed 1960) and Leon L. Lake's memoir (a telephone line at the Weigal Mtn. Lookout, and a one-acre fire associated with it). Unresolved: firelookout.com says never manned, while the memoir describes a telephone at the site; the story reports both without reconciling them. The memoir does not date the Cripple Horse fire explicitly; 1940 rests on its place in the July 1940 narrative, so the event year is inferred and flagged here. Do not confuse with Warland Peak lookout (a separate standing NHLR site, US 1506). No source describes today's condition or access; no photo found.
